examples.text: Then she told me I was ‘beautiful, for a black girl’. —Yikes!
John has lost his job and can't pay his mortgage; yikes!
EXACTLY, BLOCKHEAD!! BONK [hitting head] / AGH… / [detective watching behind door] YIKES…DID HE WAKE UP?

glosses: Expression of empathy with unpleasant or undesirable circumstances.
